items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Team Mission The Security Incident Response Team’s mission is to systematically respond to security threats safeguarding Cloudflare. We operate 24 ⁄ 7 across the globe to respond to security incidents, continuously improve our response capabilities, lead digital investigations and enhance our overall security posture. Our “Cloudflare on Cloudflare”, data and automation first philosophy makes us a cohesive team with high impact. The Role This intermediate Security Engineer role on the Security Response Team (SIRT) focuses on leading security incidents and engineering scalable response capabilities across enterprise security,vulnerability response, insider threat and privacy incidents. Incident command is a core responsibility, requiring coordination of technical investigations, containment, remediation, and stakeholder communications. This role collaborates with IT, Engineering, Product, Product Security, Detection Engineering, Privacy, and Legal teams, leveraging programming, security telemetry, and AI-powered tools to improve response effectiveness. It requires clear communication of technical findings and business impact, alongside participation in a shared on-call rotation with rotating weekend and holiday shifts. This role requires full time work over the Weekends. Candidates should be comfortable working with a Tuesday - Saturday or Sunday - Thursday 5-day working week schedule and on call rotations. Responsibilities Security Operations Oversee security event triage, validation, and response workflows, ensuring timely investigation of high-priority alerts and security anomalies. Collaborate with detection engineers and threat intelligence teams to refine investigative signals and improve security visibility. Maintain incident management processes, ensuring incidents are properly categorized, documented, and escalated as needed. Perform continuous operational improvements, such as tuning detection rules, optimizing log ingestion, and enhancing alert enrichment pipelines. Conduct security gap analysis, identifying weaknesses in monitoring coverage and recommending solutions to enhance detection and response capabilities. Work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve log collection, normalization, and visibility across diverse environments. Ensure adherence to incident response playbooks, compliance standards, and security best practices (e.g., CISA, GDPR, NIST, ISO 27001). Incident Investigation & Threat Hunting Lead forensic investigations into intrusions, insider threats, APTs, and account compromises. Perform log analysis, correlation, and anomaly detection across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry. Use Python, SQL, and data engineering techniques to extract insights from large-scale logs, identifying attacker TTPs and movement across environments. Investigate real-time security incidents, working closely with detection teams to validate alerts and escalate threats. Conduct post-incident analysis to determine root causes, document findings, and recommend mitigation strategies. Security Monitoring & Continuous Threat Analysis Oversee security monitoring operations, ensuring alert triage, enrichment, and validation align with investigative workflows. Optimize SIEM queries, log ingestion pipelines, and case management systems to improve threat visibility. Develop playbooks and workflows to streamline investigations and reduce manual effort in repetitive tasks. Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for effective response to security alerts and ongoing monitoring. Collaborate with the Detection Engineering team to refine detection rules and investigative signals based on real-world attack patterns. Security Engineering & Automation for Investigations Engineer automated solutions to enhance investigation efficiency, such as log parsing scripts, data enrichment tools, and case correlation frameworks. Build log analysis pipelines for efficient parsing, enrichment, and correlation of multi-source security data. Develop custom detection logic for brute-force attempts, lateral movement, and anomaly-based intrusion detection. Automate threat intelligence enrichment, real-time event processing, and security data visualization. Engineer scalable solutions for PCAP analysis, network flow monitoring, and cloud security event detection. Forensic Analysis & Threat Intelligence Correlation Perform disk, memory, and network forensics to uncover hidden indicators of compromise (IOCs) and attacker behaviors. Correlate multi-source logs (firewall, EDR, web, authentication logs, cloud telemetry) to reconstruct attack chains and identify attacker footholds. Analyze network traffic to detect exfiltration attempts, lateral movement, and suspicious patterns. Use threat intelligence tooling (opencti) to enrich investigations and automate IOC processing. Must-Have Qualifications 3+ years of experience in incident response, security operations, and forensic analysis Proven ability to lead crisis situations, make data-driven security decisions, and drive technical and operational improvements. Strong expertise in incident management, root cause analysis, and forensic investigation methodologies. Hands-on experience with SIEM (SQL, ELK, etc), SOAR, and EDR for real-time security monitoring and response. Experience managing large-scale security incidents, ensuring effective escalation, resolution, and business alignment. Strong understanding of threat intelligence, attacker tactics (MITRE ATT&CK), and real-world attack chains. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and security case management automation. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Certifications: GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCIH, or equivalent forensic/security certifications. Experience in Red Teaming, Threat Intelligence, or Malware Analysis. Understanding of cloud-native security monitoring (AWS, GCP, Azure). Due to this position having access to controlled technology and systems, US export control laws require that applicants for this position must be US persons (including US citizens, US nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees and asylees). What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure and pipelines to ensure reliable data flows across the organization. Requirements: 4.5+ years of experience in a data engineering role Proficiency in AWS RDS and Snowflake for database management Hands-on experience with Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect Experience with Looker Familiarity with Datadog for monitoring and performance optimization English level - B2 Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously Responsibilities : Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using tools such as Fivetran, DBT, and Prefect. Manage and administer databases on AWS RDS and Snowflake to ensure optimal performance and data integrity. items.summary: Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports docto
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You love learning complex things. Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? Apply (here: https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr ) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026. TWO IMPORTANT NOTES: We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers. We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Cor
items.description: Company Description Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide. As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group. With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group. A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company’s mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem. Job Description We are looking for a Team Leader to build and lead the IT CIB Transversal Innovation team in Porto. This is a leadership role at the intersection of people management, product and business analysis, and delivery ownership. You will lead a growing team of engineers, data scientists and analysts working on AI and agentic products used by CIB business lines. You will turn business needs into well-framed use cases, make sure the team delivers them to production, and keep the team’s work visible and trusted by sponsors and users. You will report hierarchically to the Head of IT CIB Transversal Portugal and work under the functional direction of the Head of Dev & Innovation in Paris. You will be the local point of contact for the Portugal team, Paris counterparts and the wider Portuguese IT community. This role suits a Business Analyst, Product Owner or Squad Lead who has already led a team and wants to run a delivery hub for AI solutions, with a solid understanding of the technology and the people who build it. Main responsibilities: Team leadership and talent development Lead, coach and develop a growing team of engineers, data scientists and analysts; ensure engagement, performance and career growth. Manage day-to-day priorities, workload, capacity, availability, absences and onboarding. Own people-management processes, including regular 1:1s, feedback, annual performance reviews, career conversations, talent reviews and training plans. Foster a high-performance, collaborative and psychologically safe culture across Porto, Lisbon and Paris, including employees, contractors and interns. Drive recruitment in Portugal: define role profiles, contribute to job descriptions, assess agencies and candidates, conduct interviews, and maintain a high bar. Build the team’s local presence through Portuguese universities and the technology community. Squad leadership and delivery Lead the Porto squad as a Squad Lead: set the sprint goals, run the rituals (stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives) and keep the team focused on what matters. Own the delivery of the Portugal team’s commitments, from framing through production and run; monitor objectives, risks, dependencies and corrective actions. Prioritise the backlog with Product Owners and project leaders in Paris, and arbitrate between competing requests. Estimate workload and cost of new requests, plan resources, forecast capacity and contribute to budget planning. Organise releases and go-lives with the technical teams and the business: user onboarding, deployment steps, communication and support. Remove delivery blockers with local IT partners on access, environments, tooling, security and infrastructure. Provide clear, regular quantitative and qualitative reporting on delivery, risks and staffing to management in Portugal and Paris. Business analysis and product ownership Be the interface between business teams (Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations) and the technical squad. Collect, challenge and formalise business needs; write functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria. Frame AI use cases: value, scope, data, risks, feasibility and delivery plan. Run demos and training sessions for users, and collect feedback to improve the products. Maintain the documentation of the products: functional descriptions, process maps, user guides, and the catalogue of use cases. Support new teams that want to adopt the team’s platforms and onboard them (access, data rooms, user lists, rights). Technical understanding and AI agenda Understand and challenge the technical choices of the team (architecture, stack, APIs, deployment) and explain them to non-technical stakeholders. Take part in design discussions and technical reviews alongside the engineers; be credible with developers and data scientists. Build and maintain practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG pipelines and agentic frameworks, and of the limits of these technologies. Promote responsible AI adoption in daily work, including the use of DevXAI, coding assistants and engineering agents. Ensure compliance with organisational standards, AppSec and secure software development lifecycle requirements, and audit expectations. Share reusable patterns with other teams in IT TRV Porto and the broader internal AI community. Stakeholder management Build trusted relationships with Paris counterparts, CIB IT stakeholders, business lines and Portugal-based technology teams. Represent the team in relevant local governance, management, HR, procurement and technology forums. Communicate clearly with engineers, architects, senior management and sponsors; adapt the message to the audience. Follow contractor missions, renewals and budget topics with management in Portugal and Paris. Qualifications Education Master’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline. Experience 8 to 12 years of experience in IT projects, including several years as Business Analyst, Product Owner, Project Leader or Squad Lead on software or data products. At least 3 years in a team-leadership, squad-lead or team-lead position, including direct management of people. Proven record of delivering several initiatives concurrently in an agile environment (Scrum or Kanban). Experience working with a mixed team of employees, contractors and interns, ideally on several sites. Experience in financial services, capital markets or a regulated industry is a strong asset. Experience as a developer is a plus, but not required. Skills Strong skills in requirement analysis, functional specification, user stories, backlog management and prioritisation. Good command of delivery tools (Jira, Confluence, Excel / Power BI or equivalent) and of reporting. Solid understanding of software delivery: APIs, CI/CD, environments, testing and release management. Familiarity with OpenShift, cloud environments or application security is valued. Good understanding of AI technologies (LLMs, RAG, agents) and of how to bring AI use cases to production. Hands-on experience is a plus; curiosity and the will to learn are required. Ability to estimate effort and cost, and to follow a budget. Clear writing and presentation skills, for demos, steering committees and documentation. Leadership and soft skills Autonomous, structured decision-maker who can navigate ambiguity and make people and delivery decisions under pressure. Strong coach, able to develop both junior and senior team members. Clear, assertive communicator who can influence in a matrix organisation without relying on formal authority. Pragmatic, transparent and ownership-oriented; escalates risks early and focuses on priorities. Curious and committed to continuous learning and innovation. Languages Fluent English, written and spoken, is mandatory. Portuguese is strongly preferred. French is an asset. What we offer A central role in the AI strategy of Natixis CIB, with production systems and visible business impact. The opportunity to build and shape a growing team in Portugal. Access to modern AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG and agentic systems, applied to real banking use cases. Direct collaboration with technology leaders, CIB sponsors and AI governance stakeholders in Portugal and Paris. A role combining people leadership, business understanding and concrete delivery ownership. Success indicators for the first 12 months Portugal commitments are delivered on time, with expected quality and transparent risk management. Business needs are framed clearly: specifications, estimates and priorities are agreed before the work starts. Open roles are filled, and new employees, interns and contractors are successfully onboarded. The team demonstrates engagement, cohesion and retention. Sponsors and users are satisfied with the products and the support they receive. Management in Portugal and Paris receives clear, regular reporting with no surprises. Additional Information Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

items.description: FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures. In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. To gain deeper insights into FairMoney’s pivotal role in reshaping Africa’s financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video. THE MANDATE As our product offering expands, we are looking for marketing leader to help FairMoney reach more customers and scale acquisition efficiently — growing customer volumes while making every acquisition budget work harder. You will lead FairMoney’s digital function, owning paid acquisition across Google, Meta, affiliates and other performance channels. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the acquisition strategy, manage substantial budgets and develop the in-house team, while working directly in advertising platforms, reviewing campaign data and identifying the changes needed to improve results. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Set the paid acquisition strategy across lending and banking products, translating business priorities into channel plans, campaigns and measurable targets. Lead and personally optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including mobile app acquisition, bidding, targeting, budget pacing and campaign structure. Own the acquisition budget: planning, forecasting and allocation — monitoring spend and returns, and scaling investment across channels and campaigns based on performance. Own acquisition efficiency and quality: track and improve CAC, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS and cost per activated customer, using cohort and lifetime-value insights to judge the quality of customers acquired. Run structured experiments across creatives, messaging, audiences, bidding strategies and conversion events, and partner with Brand and Design to turn insights into effective advertising. Build and manage affiliate partnerships: negotiate commercial terms and payout models, and monitor traffic quality, fraud risk and acquisition costs. Keep measurement and attribution reliable: work with Data and Engineering on app tracking, attribution and conversion signals, and investigate discrepancies between platform and business results. Optimise the full acquisition funnel with Product, Risk and CRM — from click and install through registration, activation and first product usage, we need the right customer at the right time. Lead and coach the in-house performance marketing team, set clear goals, and present results, forecasts and recommended actions to the management team. Develop new channels: evaluate new paid acquisition opportunities and scale those that demonstrate repeatable results. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Scaled performance marketing in financial services. Has led and scaled performance marketing in fintech, consumer lending, digital banking or other consumer financial services. Emerging-markets experience is preferred. Senior acquisition leadership. 7+ years in performance marketing or digital acquisition, including leading a team and owning acquisition outcomes in a B2C business. Deep, hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise. A recent, proven record of scaling mobile app or consumer acquisition campaigns. Budget ownership at scale. Has managed substantial paid marketing budgets, including planning, forecasting, allocation and performance reporting. Proven efficient growth. Can show where they improved acquisition efficiency while increasing customer volumes, with clear examples and measurable results. Strong affiliate marketing experience. Including partner management, commercial negotiations and traffic-quality assessment. Technical measurement fluency. Strong understanding of mobile attribution, app events, conversion tracking and value-based bidding; able to troubleshoot measurement issues with technical teams. Strong analytical judgment. A practical command of CAC, CPA, ROAS, LTV, payback and cohort performance. Builder and player-coach. Can build and develop an in-house team while staying closely involved in campaign execution and optimisation. NICE TO HAVE Attribution and analytics tooling. Experience with Adjust, AppsFlyer or similar platforms, alongside Firebase, GA4 and business intelligence tools. Advanced analysis and automation. SQL or other advanced analytical skills, and practical use of AI or automation to improve campaign analysis, creative testing or reporting. EXPECTATION ON AI Plan in AI-era timelines. Challenge campaign and testing plans that assume pre-AI cycle times, and compress launch, test and learning loops from weeks into days. Make the team AI-native operators. Expect marketers to use AI directly for creative variants, copy, audience analysis, reporting and campaign diagnostics. Redesign the acquisition workflow. Jointly define with Data, Design and Engineering where AI is used across creative production, testing, bidding, measurement and reporting. Measure AI leverage. Track creative testing velocity, time-to-insight, output per marketer and acquisition efficiency against pre-AI baselines. Scale what works. Turn successful AI-native practices into playbooks, tooling and operating standards across the Growth team. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Efficient growth New-customer volumes grow materially while CAC and CPA improve across channels. Quality customers Acquired cohorts activate and use our products, with LTV and payback improving across lending and banking. A team that owns outcomes Attribution is trusted, budget moves on evidence, and each team member owns clear channel targets. 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET) Training & Development budget Paid company business trips Recruitment Process: Screening session with a member of the recruitment team. Technical Interview with the Chief Growth Officer Case Study Panel Session to discuss case study Final Interview with the executive team

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@ 6sense.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6sense-business-solutions-partner-enterprise-ai

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Turkey URL: https://sezzle.com The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. I like how the company is transparent about its business model and anyone can contribute with an idea for its improvement. The culture within the team is unique and everyone is talented and skillful in their profession. We set goals guided by virtues created by the team rather than the traditional core values. ” - Jeff Miralles / iOS Developer Are you someone who is DRIVING themselves to peak performance? Are you excited by HELPING PEOPLE create technology that impacts millions every day? If you answered YES to these questions, you may be a fit for Appetiser Apps . Join a high-performance team who are striving to go from an Australian market leader to a worldwide phenomenon. Our competitors cannot keep up with our technology, pace, and track record of successful clients. We need ambitious people like YOU to help us grow by 10X over the next 5 years. YOU WILL: BUILD beautiful websites using HTML and CSS to bring creative ideas to life. COLLABORATE with designers and developers to create web apps and backend mobile solutions. COORDINATE with teams to launch content, setting clear timelines and expectations. PLAN for the unexpected by preparing backup solutions to ensure site reliability. GROW and maintain the website by expanding its features and keeping content fresh. LEAD projects and, when needed, take charge of a team from start to finish. ADAPT quickly and take on new tasks as they arise. Requirements ​​The right fit for this role is DETERMINED, CURIOUS and EAGER TO GROW with : Has at least 1 year of post-graduate working experience Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of their learning Is hungry to improve every day and open to feedback Understands core programming fundamentals and is excited to build real-world applications Has built mobile projects (school, internship, freelance, bootcamp, or personal apps) Preferably less than 30 years old BONUS : Experience in Agentic AI Frontend/Backend Basic understanding of Git for version control Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code Basic knowledge of unit testing principles Understanding of how APIs work (REST fundamentals) Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) Stable internet connection (minimum 30 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload ) Own laptop/desktop capable of handling development work Backend: Nice to have: Experience building projects using any modern backend framework (e.g., PHP/Laravel or similar architecture) Understanding of databases and basic SQL schema design Knowledge of clean coding principles (e.g., SOLID fundamentals ) Basic understanding of RESTful API design and testing (e.g., Postman, Insomnia, or similar tools) Exposure to deployment processes or cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar) is a plus Frontend: Comfortable with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, Vuejs Experience working with any modern frontend framework/library Understanding of responsive design and reusable component architecture Exposure to testing tools or static typing (e.g., TypeScript) is a bonus Join our team! Flexible Work Arrangements: The ability to work from anywhere in the world as long as you perform. Accelerate Your Career: After your probation period, you’ll receive regular performance and salary reviews every 6 months, giving you clear opportunities to advance based on your impact, growth, and contributions. Fast-Track Junior Progression: Every 4 months, you’ll have the opportunity for a performance and compensation review, ensuring your hard work and improvement are recognized early and often. Your career progression is merit-based; the more you learn, take initiative, and consistently deliver quality work, the faster you can level up. Become Your Best: Set personal & professional goals every quarter with your talent coach. Get optional counselling along the way. Global Impact: Build products that reach users worldwide and truly make a difference in the world! Public Recognition: Track your achievements as you build a personalportfolio & track record. Join a Culture of Drivers : Become part of a team that’s striving to be their very best. Monthly salary ranges from AUD 420–600 , depending on hiring region, experience, and local market benchmarks. If this resonates with you, please apply today. P.S. We're hiring multiple individuals. If you want to recommend someone, please email us; an attractive referral bonus awaits! P.P.S. If you have any questions, email us at Originally posted on Himalayas
