items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What’s the opportunity? The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution. What will I be doing? Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations. Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact. Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin. Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development. Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact. What skills do I need? Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes. Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering. High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing. Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical. Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using. Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI. Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand. Bonus skills and attributes Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science. Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on. Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow. *Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the New York Area is $206,000- $229,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). #LI-Hybrid Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Policies Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values . Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-forward-deployed-data-scientist

items.title: Senior Data Engineer
items.summary: Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us. New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now. Two ways to work with clients Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it. Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process. Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own. What you get Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences. Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours. No micromanagement, no screen trackers Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries Who we’re looking for Senior Data Engineers with: 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production. You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents). Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls. You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision. You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks. NOT YOUR TECH STACK? We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, Magento & PHP, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you. We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire. We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

items.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
items.summary: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.Â We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal â not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. Your Area of Focus Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. Your Professional Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production. SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions. Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this: Zone 1: National Average Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions Zone 3: High-Cost Regions Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen. Zone 1 (National Average) $127,000 â $145,000 USD Â About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing â so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout â helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more atÂ www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the CustomerÂ We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay EntrepreneurialÂ We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. Perks & BenefitsÂ United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Costa Rica: To assist with all of lifeâs needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences. Compliance & Privacy Disclosures NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/ If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us atÂ talentacquisition@tebra.com Â and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too. As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded. Please mention the word **ASSURANCE** and tag RMjAuODAuMTA4LjE2OA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuODAuMTA4LjE2OA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term. As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment. We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. What the work looks like for our data team: Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement Serve as technical partner to program teams Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies Load-test our systems to prepare for elections Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar. This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. Responsibilities Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations Strong proficiency in SQL and Python Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar Nice to Have: Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters Experience on Google Cloud Platform Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply. Base salary of $90,000-$150,000 Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off Remote first culture with teammates all around the country. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com. Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. About the Role: We are seeking a driven, high-energy individual who is passionate about new business acquisition and enterprise sales. As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan within your assigned territory, focusing on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including solution engineering (pre-sales), marketing, and professional services, to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success. This is a remote position with a requirement to be based in Illinois or Minnesota. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a strategic territory plan targeting key organizations and applicable use cases to build a robust pipeline and achieve quarterly and annual sales objectives. Become an expert in our product offerings and industry solutions, delivering compelling demos, presentations, and proposals that clearly articulate business value. Leverage deep knowledge of the market to position our solutions as the best fit for customer needs, highlighting the advantages over competing technologies and approaches. Lead complex sales cycles with a solution-based approach, employing strategic selling strategies and tactics, including the Land & Expand model to grow accounts. Manage the full sales process from prospecting to closing, consistently securing new logos and expanding within existing accounts. Develop strong partnerships with public cloud providers (AWS, Google, Microsoft Azure) and leverage these relationships to drive growth opportunities. Proven ability to independently develop and close new client relationships while effectively managing long-term business engagements. Deep understanding of commercial open-source business models, including selling on-premise and cloud & SaaS hybrid solutions. Strong presentation, communication, and organizational skills with a knack for building strong business champions. items.summary: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch
items.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com. Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. About the Team At Life360, the Marketing team is a highly valued contributor to the business. From creating demand to converting that demand to expanding our relationships with members, the Marketing team is at the forefront of telling the Life360 story and how it can help make everyday family life better. We prioritize bold thinking, principled risks and entrepreneurial thinking. And, we give our marketers the freedom and autonomy to make the decisions they feel are best for the brand and the business. It’s an exciting time to be on the Life360 global Marketing team! About the Job Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, the Senior Director of Performance Marketing owns demand acceleration and conversion across consumer acquisition in our core and emerging markets including US, UK, Australia, Canada and Germany, with additional markets coming online each year. You will partner closely with the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing to close the funnel. Their work creates the demand, yours accelerates and converts it, and the two only work as one motion. This is a builder’s role at the frontier of how paid media gets done. You will lead a team and a set of agency and technology partners across paid social, search, app-install, programmatic and App Store Optimization (ASO) channels, and you will push us to build, buy and deploy AI and agentic systems that plan, bid, create, test and optimize media faster and smarter than a manual process ever could. You own the day-to-day: the channel plans, the budgets, the bidding and creative-testing engines, the experimentation roadmap and the reporting that tells us what is working. The international scope is the part that makes this role different. Each market is at a different stage of brand awareness and subscription maturity, so the right performance playbook, efficiency target and level of automation will vary by market. You will partner deeply with marketing leaders across creative and social, product marketing, journey marketing, comms and with functional teams outside marketing (data science and analytics, design, finance) and product/eng teams (subscription growth, devices). Your performance connects directly to the company’s key goals — brand, free user growth, and financial — and this is a high visibility role. The US-based salary range for this position is $171,000 to $266,000. We take into consideration an individual’s background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) _, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits._ What You’ll Do Own the performance marketing strategy and budget accountability for acquisition efficiency and free user growth across markets including US, UK, AU, CA and DE, driving toward the company’s goals for MAU and Quality New Reg. Scale spend profitably across paid social, search, app-install networks, programmatic, and emerging channels, setting the targets for CAC, ROAS, payback and LTV that guide where the next dollar goes. Own App Store Optimization (ASO) as a core acquisition lever, including keyword strategy, metadata, creative and screenshot testing, Custom Product Pages and store listing localization by market, to lift organic installs and store conversion rate. Be responsible for and drive AI and agentic systems for media and optimization — including automated bidding and budget allocation, creative generation and testing at scale, anomaly detection, forecasting and reporting. Run a rigorous experimentation program across channels, audiences, creative, landing experiences and funnel stages, and turn results into scaled playbooks. Work hand in hand with the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing so brand and demand creation feed performance, and performance learnings sharpen brand and demand creation. Share one view of the funnel, one calendar and one set of goals. Partner with creativel on a high-velocity creative testing engine, including adaptation and localization for international markets. Translate global strategy into market-level media plans, flighting and budgets, working with regional agency partners and in-market teams on local nuance: media landscape, competitive set, cultural context, language and regulatory and privacy requirements. Partner with Data Science, Analytics and Finance on attribution, incrementality testing, marketing mix and econometric modeling that hold up at both a global and a market level, including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data. Own the performance budget day to day across markets: build the plans, track pacing, reallocate as results dictate, and serve as the VP’s right hand on forecast and performance. Lead the development of metric dashboards in partnership with the Data Analytics team and agency partners, giving leadership full visibility into performance across channels and markets, and run the forums where those insights get shared with leadership and other vested constituents. Lead, coach and grow a high performing team working across time zones, and hold agency partners to a high standard. What We’re Looking For 15+ years of performance marketing experience, with 4+ years leading teams in the app marketing space. Proven success scaling app businesses. You have taken a consumer app from early traction to significant, profitable scale, with a track record of growing spend while holding or improving efficiency, and can show the numbers. Hands-on experience building or using AI and agentic models for media and optimization. You have put AI to work in production, for example in automated bidding and budgeting, creative generation and testing, forecasting, or agent-driven campaign management, and can speak to what worked, what didn’t and the results. Deep expertise across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Pinterest, Reddit), search, app-install networks, Apple Search Ads and programmatic, and deep fluency in mobile measurement (MMPs such as AppsFlyer), Google privacy-preserving frameworks) and a privacy-first landscape. Consumer subscription experience strongly preferred. Freemium model experience is highly beneficial. Experience running performance marketing across multiple countries at once, building an efficient portfolio of acquisition across different strategies and market maturities. Strong understanding of attribution, incrementality testing, marketing mix and econometric modeling, including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data. Strong analytical and technical fluency: comfortable with SQL, dashboards and working directly with data scientists and engineers to build custom tooling, models and automation. Experience managing agency and technology partners, including regional or local-market agencies. Belief that performance and brand building work as one motion, and the ability to work in lockstep with an Integrated Marketing counterpart toward shared goals. Exceptional cross-functional collaborator who can work effectively across time zones. Stellar communicator. Can distill complex stories down and communicate persuasively in both written and verbal modalities. While data-informed, embraces the grayscale nature of marketing and complements empiricism with judgment and intuition. A strong leader of people and someone who truly buys into our values. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees) Paid parental leave 401(k) plan with company matching program Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns Learning & Development programs Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote

We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service. Your focus will of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management. Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals. Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. Qualifications You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok). You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles. You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs. You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization. You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives. You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more! The Use of Artificial Intelligence Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent. Hiring Eligibility by Location While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship. Beware of Hiring Scams Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse). Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to support our Marketing Data Science team and accelerate new member growth through predictive modeling and advanced analytics. You'll build prospect targeting and conversion prediction models that help Oportun identify promising prospective members, improve acquisition conversion rates, and reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC). You'll own models end to end—from feature development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—in partnership with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You'll develop and deploy machine learning models for prospect targeting and conversion prediction to increase new member acquisition. You'll analyze internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing campaign and engagement data, third-party consumer and alternative data, and credit bureau data to build predictive features and identify growth opportunities. You'll apply statistical and machine learning methods, including logistic regression, gradient boosting, and related techniques, to improve targeting accuracy and conversion rates. You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring. You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows. You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You're a curious, rigorous data scientist who turns complex data into reliable models and practical business decisions. You enjoy ambiguous growth problems, take ownership of outcomes, and balance predictive performance with measurable acquisition impact. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, predictive modeling, or a related field. Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets. Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems. Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production machine learning models. Experience building reusable data preparation, feature engineering, and model scoring pipelines. Ability to assess model performance, data quality, and business outcomes and communicate clear recommendations. Strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and project ownership skills. Nice to Have Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, prospect targeting, or conversion propensity modeling. Experience with internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing engagement data, third-party consumer or alternative data, or credit bureau data. Experience with AWS, SageMaker, EMR, Spark SQL, Hive, or similar cloud and large-scale data technologies. Experience in consumer lending, fintech, credit risk, or fraud risk. Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve modeling, coding, documentation, or research workflows. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance. Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance. Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-r14369

items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Business Development and Client Engagement Manager Salary: Php 80,000 to Php 100,000/month Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care. Operating across Western Australia, we deliver trusted Supported Independent Living (SIL), community participation, and specialised support services designed to empower participants and foster long-term independence. Our culture is rooted in genuine empathy, rigorous service standards, and collaborative community partnerships. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Business Development and Client Engagement Manager to spearhead our market expansion and drive participant intake across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Reporting directly to leadership and collaborating closely with the Operations Manager, you will operate as an "A+ Hunter"—proactively identifying referral opportunities, cultivating strategic relationships across the disability and healthcare ecosystems, and managing the end-to-end conversion cycle. This is an autonomous, high-impact field sales role where your commercial acumen, networking capability, and relentless follow-through will directly translate into sustainable service growth and full SIL occupancy. RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Outreach & Referral Generation Conduct outbound prospecting to identify and secure referral streams across Perth and Western Australia. Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Support Coordinators, Psychosocial Recovery Coaches, hospital discharge teams, allied health professionals, mental health networks, and justice-transition services. Coordinate and attend targeted field visits and partner meetings to pitch service offerings and establish sustainable intake pipelines. Lead Management & Conversion Respond rapidly to participant enquiries (acknowledgement within 2 business hours) and drive structured lead qualification. Organise and facilitate participant intake meetings, service suitability assessments, and accommodation inspections. Collaborate closely with the Operations Manager to verify service capacity, staffing logistics, and participant matching before finalising agreements. Draft accurate service proposals, quotations, and service agreements, driving follow-ups to achieve prompt execution. SIL Vacancy Management & Service Expansion Actively market and promote available Supported Independent Living (SIL) vacancies across relevant networks. Coordinate property viewings, engage with families and decision-makers, and support safe, appropriate participant compatibility matching. Pinpoint emerging service demands in regional and metropolitan catchments to advise on future property and service expansions. Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Deliver weekly pipeline updates, conversion analysis, and field-activity schedules every Monday by 10:00 AM. Produce monthly performance reviews evaluating channel effectiveness, onboarding numbers, SIL occupancy, and revenue growth. Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional B2B business development, sales, or client acquisition experience within Australia. Industry Acumen: Sound working knowledge of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), SIL funding mechanisms, and the broader WA human services/health landscape. Clearances: Valid (or ability to immediately obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Check, National Police Clearance, and Working with Children Check (WWCC). Preferred Proven track record in a similar growth role within an NDIS registered provider, healthcare provider, or community organisation in Western Australia. An established network of active contacts among Perth-based Support Coordinators, LACs, hospital social workers, and community mental health organisations. Experience navigating complex participant matching and intake workflows within Supported Independent Living (SIL) settings. What You’ll Bring A True Hunter Mindset: Highly proactive and self-motivated, with the grit to initiate cold outreach, build pipelines from scratch, and turn conversations into committed placements. Relationship Focus: Exceptional interpersonal communication and presentation skills that build immediate credibility with industry professionals, participants, and support networks. Accountability & Commercial Rigour: Clear focus on activity metrics and KPIs, taking personal ownership of pipeline velocity, follow-up cadence, and conversion outcomes. Ethical Boundary Management: A consultative, compliant approach that balances commercial targets with participant safety, operational capacity, and strict person-centred care principles. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-business-development-and-client-engagement-manager-dayshift-remote
