items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg

With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high. Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission Qualifications What You'll Bring 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred). Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Additional Information When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture. Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics. Before You Apply From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations. Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wisetech-global-e2open-us-area-sales-director-cpg-washington

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! Unsere Vision? Wir bauen das beste Livetrainingsangebot für Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Markt auf! Aktuell haben wir zu viele hungrige Interessenten und brauchen dringend High-Performer, die sich unsere Mission anschließen wollen. Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist und massiv wachsen möchtest - bewirb dich noch heute bei uns! Art der Stelle: Festanstellung, ggf. Freelance To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lotaro-head-of-lead-generation-remote-m-w-d

items.title: Performance Test Engineer
items.summary: Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated rem
items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. Someone comfortable analyzing data and communicating technical findings. A proactive team player who can work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. An engineer interested in leveraging AI and automation to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity. A strong desire to learn new performance engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies. What we offer you: Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important. “Take What You Need” time off policy. Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode. Generous 401k match to help save for your future . Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day. Compensation Transparency In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location. Job Grade: Career Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-performance-test-engineer

items.summary: Headquarters: El Salvador URL: http://thrivedigital.com Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Job Details Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Department: Performance Job Location: Remote (El Salvador) Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours) Compensation: $41,000 - $50,000 USD + Benefits
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: El Salvador URL: http://thrivedigital.com Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Job Details Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen) Department: Performance Job Location: Remote (El Salvador) Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours) Compensation: $41,000 - $50,000 USD + Benefits Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation. Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. Qualifications You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others). You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level. You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals. You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables. You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more! The Use of Artificial Intelligence Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent. Hiring Eligibility by Location While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship. Beware of Hiring Scams Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse). Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thrive-digital-performance-strategist-demand-gen-performance-marketing-el-salvador

We value creative thinking, authenticity, and quality. Ready to join our community? Dive into the Itecor experience and become our new colleague as: QA Performance Engineer missions 🛠 Define and execute the performance testing strategy. Create realistic workload models based on business volumes and user behavior. Design, script, execute, and maintain performance test scenarios. Perform load, stress, soak/endurance, and scalability testing. Monitor application and infrastructure performance during test execution. Analyze response times, throughput, error rates, concurrency, and resource utilization. Identify performance bottlenecks and propose improvements. Collaborate with Development and DevOps teams to resolve performance issues. Prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations. Support application scalability, stability, and capacity planning. your profile 👀 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance. Proven experience in performance testing. Strong hands-on experience with performance testing tools (ideally NeoLoad). Knowledge of load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing methodologies. Experience in performance test scripting and scenario maintenance. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to interpret performance metrics and identify root causes. Understanding of application architecture, APIs, and databases. Familiarity with cloud environments and distributed systems. Experience with monitoring and observability tools. Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical teams. itecor, trusted advisor for your digital transformation Itecor is an international IT boutique consultancy headquartered in Switzerland. As a trusted advisor, we bring our customers’ visions to life through digital transformation. We boast over 240 employees across 8 offices (Vevey, Geneva, Zurich, Paris, Barcelona, Skopje, Mexico, Durango). We specialise in Governance, implementation of digital solutions, and Quality Assurance. Close to our clients, delivering high value-added services, embodying applied innovation, and empowering people: these are the core values we have been pursuing for over 30 years. items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

You will contribute to pre-season planning and in-season trading, while developing analytical tools and processes to support better commercial decision-making. Working closely with colleagues across Brand Partnerships, Business Development, Online Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Product and Business Insights, you will help translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. Produce actionable insights and recommendations to optimise supply, improve product availability and maximise sales. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and analytical tools, working with BI and other technical teams to improve business visibility. Support analysis of key commercial initiatives, including markdown optimisation, next-day delivery and exclusive products. Present findings through regular trade meetings, business reviews and project updates. Support with ad-hoc analysis and requests from senior management and business development Planning Support Merchandise Planning & Analytics managers in pre-season planning for key brand partners, using historical performance and demand trends to inform supply and assortment recommendations. Refresh and maintain sales forecasting and planning models, supporting target setting and scenario analysis. Monitor sales and stock performance against targets and forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities. Identify supply opportunities and recommend actions to improve product availability and maximise sales. Support ongoing forecasting and planning updates, contributing to the development of more effective planning models and processes WHO YOU ARE Collaborative, flexible and approachable, with pride in the quality of your work and an understanding that how you work is just as important as what you deliver. Previous experience in Merchandise Planning, Buying, Demand or Supply Planning, Analytics or Consulting, ideally within the fashion or luxury industry. An understanding of the fashion and luxury industry and its commercial drivers. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis using large data sets . Excellent planning and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail. Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Proactive and curious, with the ability to identify opportunities and challenge existing ways of working. Comfortable managing competing priorities and working to deadlines in a fast-paced environment, ability to escalate challenges to management Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the understanding of how present findings clearly to different audiences. Technical skills for processing and analysing large amounts of data: Excel (mid level) and SQL (preferred, basic level) . Looker or equivalent BI tools (desirable). items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position : Digital Marketing Specialist Salary : Up to $2,400 NZD per month Working Hours & Conditions : Part-Time, aligned with New Zealand business hours Work Arrangement : Remote ABOUT THE COMPANY: An innovative B2B SaaS platform serving the Allied Health clinic sector. By integrating directly with leading Patient Management Systems, their software provides branded, web-based patient intake forms and dedicated check-in kiosk solutions that streamline clinical operations and enhance the patient journey. Backed by an established strategic roadmap and marketing leadership, the organization is scaling its multi-channel footprint and market reach. ROLE OVERVIEW: Working directly alongside the Marketing Growth Lead, the Marketing Specialist acts as the core tactical execution engine for the brand. This role bridges high-level strategy and day-to-day operations by managing content output, web pages, email nurture sequences, and multi-channel campaigns. It is designed for an autonomous, execution-focused professional who excels at turning strategic roadmaps into measurable pipeline momentum in a fully remote setup. RESPONSIBILITIES: Content Production: Write, edit, and publish blog posts, resources, and case studies that speak to Allied Health clinic owners and practice managers. Manage the content calendar and maintain a consistent publishing cadence. Website & Landing Pages: Build and update pages in Webflow — including landing pages, feature pages, and conversion-focused content — to support campaigns and improve the buyer journey. Email Marketing: Set up and execute email campaigns including nurture sequences, onboarding flows, and re-engagement campaigns using our email marketing platform. Campaign Execution: Deploy and monitor marketing campaigns across B2B channels, including paid acquisition when required. Social Media: Maintain a consistent, high-quality presence across relevant social platforms. Plan, create, and schedule posts that build awareness and drive traffic. Review & Reputation Campaigns: Drive customer review campaigns to build social proof on relevant platforms. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign and channel performance, pull basic reporting, and flag what's working and what isn't. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you should be comfortable reading dashboards and reporting on key metrics. Momentum Building: Proactively identifying the next steps needed to keep our growth roadmap on track. What We're Looking For Execution Focus: You love the "doing" part of marketing and take pride in seeing a plan come to life. Eye for design: Good instincts for layout, imagery, and visual consistency. You can create professional-looking assets without needing a designer for every task. Self-Starters: You are proactive and comfortable working independently within a defined strategy. Reliability: You are a consistent "engine" who can be counted on to deliver high-quality work. Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape. Highly Desirable Direct background or familiarity with the Allied Health, healthcare, or clinic management software industry. Tech-forward mindset with an appetite for adopting modern AI tools to augment workflows, accelerate output, and maintain high operational leverage. Prior experience managing multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-part-time-digital-marketing-specialist

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX About the Role We are seeking a Sr. Procurement Operations Lead, Infrastructure to support the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for infrastructure hardware across our global environment. This individual will partner closely with Capacity Planning, Infrastructure Engineering, Portfolio Management, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Finance, Logistics, and Strategic Sourcing teams to ensure critical hardware is procured, tracked, received, and managed efficiently. This role combines operational excellence with continuous improvement. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex business challenges, and is passionate about improving processes through automation, data analysis, and technology-driven solutions. What You’ll Do Procurement Operations & PO Management Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of hardware procurement requests from intake through receipt. Create, review, and maintain purchase requisitions and purchase orders in enterprise procurement systems with a high degree of accuracy. Monitor open purchase orders and proactively manage changes, delays, cancellations, and supplier communications. Partner with Infrastructure teams to ensure timely procurement of data center and hardware assets. Coordinate with suppliers to obtain quotations, order confirmations, shipment updates, and delivery timelines. Ensure procurement activities align with company policies, controls, and approval requirements. Data Center Services & Overall Support Manage end-to-end purchase requisition and purchase order (PO) lifecycles for the Data Center Services organization, ensuring accurate PO creation, timely approvals, and ongoing maintenance (change orders, renewals, and closures). Partner with Accounts Payable and Data Center Services stakeholders to investigate and resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, billing discrepancies, and payment issues. Serve as the dedicated Procurement Operations point of contact for the Data Center Services team, providing day-to-day operational support, resolving workflow bottlenecks, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies. Infrastructure and Asset Management Partner with Capacity Planning teams to support forecasting and hardware demand planning activities. Collaborate with Fixed Assets teams to ensure accurate capitalization and asset tracking. Maintain visibility into hardware inventory levels, deployment status, and lifecycle management activities. Support inventory reconciliation efforts and asset audits as required. Track advanced shipment notifications and coordinate receiving activities across multiple locations. Ensure hardware receipts are accurately recorded within the ERP system to enable invoice processing and asset management. Supplier Management & Onboarding Initiate supplier onboarding requests and partner with supplier enablement teams to ensure timely, frictionless activation of new vendors. Maintain supplier information, assist with vendor-related issue resolution, and guide stakeholders through the onboarding workflow. Support supplier performance reviews through reporting and operational metrics. Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment-related inquiries. Process Improvement and Innovation Identify opportunities to simplify and improve procurement and infrastructure workflows. Leverage data, reporting, and technology to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency. Partner with internal technology teams to evaluate automation opportunities across procurement processes. Develop dashboards, reporting, and insights that improve decision-making and operational visibility. Support implementation of new tools, systems, and digital solutions that enhance the procurement experience. Document processes and create scalable operating procedures that support organizational growth. What You’ll Bring Three to seven years of experience in procurement, supply chain, operations, infrastructure procurement, or hardware purchasing. Experience creating and managing purchase orders within Oracle and Coupa platforms. Strong understanding of hardware procurement, data center operations, inventory management, receiving processes, and supplier onboarding. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, Infrastructure, Operations, and Procurement. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience leveraging automation, workflow technologies, analytics, or emerging technologies to improve business processes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience building reports, dashboards, or workflow automations. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting data center infrastructure procurement. Experience with Oracle, Coupa, and Zip. Experience with inventory management, fixed asset accounting, and capitalization processes. Understanding of infrastructure hardware categories including servers, networking equipment, storage, and related technology assets. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Job title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist – AI Trainer Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: California; New York; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Georgia; Remote - Ohio; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Pennsylvania; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington; Remote - Washington D.C. GAQ327R240 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale. Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth. The impact you will have: Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers. Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes. Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership. Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses. Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances. Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations. What we look for: Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting. Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance. Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies. Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework. Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules. M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential. The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus. Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented. Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach
