items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

items.title: P2P Regional Operations - Africa
items.summary: About Us Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance. Â Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution. Â Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services. About the Role As part of the Bybit Fiat team, we are looking for a P2P Regional Operations Manager to own regional growth strategy and day-to-day operational performance in Africa. You will lead a small team of regional Business Development specialists, partner closely with local teams on the ground, and serve as the regional growth engine to accommodate global P2P strategy, develop localised strategy and turn the strategy into execution. Â Reporting to the Global P2P Operations & COE Lead, you will be accountable for P2P regional growth target, merchant ecosystem development, regional product rollouts, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Community, and Customer Service. This is a regional team leader role for someone who is equally comfortable in strategy thinking and solid market-level execution. Key Responsibilities Regional Operational Ownership â¢ Own day-to-day P2P business performance across Africa markets and other assigned regions. â¢ Monitor regional OKR including transaction volume, competitiveness, disputes, and fraud patterns, etc. â¢ Identify operational bottlenecks and propose data-driven solutions to improve platform efficiency and user experience. â¢ Provide localised business insights to the P2P Ops Lead, own regional strategy and contribute to product roadmap. Team Leadership â¢ Lead, coach, and develop a small team of regional Business Development managers covering target markets. â¢ Set clear targets, structured workflows, and review cadences for the BD team. â¢ Identify capability gaps and actively drive upskilling, hiring, and team development. â¢ Foster a performance-driven, collaborative, and ownership-led culture. Merchant Ecosystem Development â¢ Drive merchant onboarding, relationship management, performance tracking, incentive programs, and quality improvements across the region. â¢ Oversee and grow merchant community to maintain a healthy, active, and engaged P2P ecosystem. â¢ Serve as the primary liaison between Bybit and the regional merchant community. Cross-functional & Local Coordination â¢ Coordinate with local market teams to align operations with country-specific dynamics, regulations, and user behavior. â¢ Work with Product to communicate regional needs, test new P2P features, and support local rollout. â¢ Work with Risk and Compliance to ensure safe P2P operations (fraud prevention) and adherence to local regulatory requirements. â¢ Collaborate with Marketing and Community on regional campaigns and user education. â¢ Coordinate with Customer Service to support dispute resolution and ensure efficient handling of user cases. â¢ Execute and continuously contribute operational SOPs, working with P2P COE. Market Insights & Growth â¢ Analyze regional P2P market trends, pricing dynamics, payment methods, and competitive landscape. â¢ Surface insights from market research and merchant feedback to Product, Risk, Compliance, and CS, working with COE â¢ Lead regional P2P go-to-market initiatives and growth campaigns in partnership with Marketing. â¢ Drive execution of user acquisition initiatives and campaign rollouts What We're Looking For Must Have â¢ 5+ years of relevant experience in operations, business development, or product operations â ideally in crypto, fintech, tech., marketplaces, or adjacent sectors. â¢ 2+ years of proven experience leading or coordinating small teams. â¢ Hands-on experience operating across multiple countries or markets. â¢ Strong understanding of operational workflows, project management best practices, and structured execution. â¢ Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills â¢ Strategic thinking and analytical mindset: comfortable with dashboards, data-driven decision-making, and translating numbers into strategy and actions. â¢ Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a strong plus. â¢ Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environment. Nice to Have â¢ Direct experience with P2P platforms, crypto exchanges, or digital asset ecosystems. â¢ Familiarity with merchant management in a marketplace or P2P environment. â¢ Exposure to risk monitoring, anti-fraud methods, KYC/KYB processes, or transaction oversight. â¢ Experience with growth campaigns, user acquisition, or market launches. â¢ Passion for blockchain, financial inclusion, and the future of decentralized finance. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â Our benefits include: - Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. - Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. - Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. - Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. - Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path. Please mention the word **HEARTILY** and tag RMjAuODAuMTA4LjE2OA== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuODAuMTA4LjE2OA==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Postdoc PhD PhD cand. Physics Computer Science
items.summary: NIKI is looking for a Postdoc/PhD/PhD cand. in Physics, Computer Science or similar discipline for industrial projects in the automotive industry. Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering! If you are a Postdoc/PhD/PhD candidate looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume. Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress. What to expect Be a member of a TOP team: Highly qualified, innovative, and interconnected. Get involved with topics at the forefront of technology: Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Driving, E-Mobility, Model Based Systems Engineering, or Virtual Experience. Acquire social skills and engage with professionals in the field of automotive and innovation. Collaborate with international groups of professionals on different projects. Ability to expand knowledge and responsibilities. An opportunity to influence the direction of a fast-growing area of business. Task Description Contribute to industry-focused R&D projects in Computer Science or Physics, with a focus on practical applications Utilize programming languages such as C++, Python, or MATLAB to develop algorithms, analyze data, and optimize solutions for industry-specific challenges Apply data analysis techniques to extract insights and employ critical thinking and creative solutions, ensuring project objectives are met Collaborate with industry partners and external teams to implement innovative solutions in real-world projects Prepare technical reports, project documentation, and presentations for stakeholders, summarizing progress, findings, and solutions Continuously stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and methodologies, integrating them into ongoing and future projects Basic Qualifications Postdoc, PhD graduate or PhD candidate in Physics or Computer Science or similar discipline Strong academic background with relevant coursework and research experience Experience with data analysis, data visualization and programming languages, such as C++, Python or MATLAB Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think critically Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a collaborative environment What we offer Structured learning on the job, professional feedback, and a mentor open to all your questions. Innovative, highly technically demanding industry and research projects, interdisciplinary teams, and highly qualified colleagues. Open doors, and the chance to take over responsibility quickly â participate, shape, and leave your fingerprint. Discover new talents and shape your career path: Become a specialist, project manager, or manager. Simultaneous, collaborative work using modern digital platforms. Workplace flexibility. Flexible working hours thanks to our attractive flextime model - only compatible projects. Enjoy working with great colleagues in your day-to-day work. Are you intrigued to find out more about this position? Then apply for a job with us! items.description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Finance. DEINE MISSION Als Senior Oracle Data Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Datenbanklösungen und gestaltest performante, sichere Anwendungen auf Basis von Oracle-Technologien. Du bringst deine Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL und Oracle Data Integrator ein, koordinierst das Entwicklerteam und sorgst mit sicherem Auftreten dafür, dass Projektleitung und Endkunde jederzeit bestens abgeholt sind. Deine Aufgaben: Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenbanklösungen auf Basis von Oracle sowie SQL und PL/SQL Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Integrationsprozessen mit Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) sind wünschenswert Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung für Themen und Anforderungen im Projektkontext Aktive Unterstützung und Koordination des Entwicklerteams Zügige Einarbeitung in neue Technologien und Themenstellungen Nutzung von Jira und Confluence zur Planung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung der Entwicklungsarbeiten Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie Visual Studio Code Moderation, Kommunikation und adressatengerechte Vermittlung technischer Inhalte Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden DAS IST UNS WICHTIG Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Oracle-Datenbanken sowie SQL und PL/SQL Grundkenntnisse in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) Erfahrung mit Jira und Confluence Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen, beispielsweise Visual Studio Code Fähigkeit zur Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung Gute Moderations-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte adressatengerecht zu vermitteln Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Nice to have: Data-Vault-Datenmodellierung Containerisierung mit Podman Oracle Analytics Server Oracle APEX DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert. Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich. Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst. Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung. Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest. Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7. JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst. items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: Canada (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. About the Role: Our QA-Core team exists so every engineering team at Upgrade can test their software quickly and trust the result. We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer on the team to architect and build test automation infrastructure, tooling, and agentic solutions to increase engineering productivity. This is not a traditional product QA role - it’s a build role. You will work closely with our product teams to understand their automation requirements, design services from scratch, ship them to production clusters and own them. This is a fully remote position open to candidates who are based in Canada. The base salary range for this position is between $150,000-$190,000 CAN. An individual’s actual base pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience. Our Core Technologies Include: Java, Python, Kubernetes, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, Grafana, SumoLogic, Docker, Gatling, Claude Code, MCP server What You’ll Do: Design and own automation framework for functional and performance testing. Build agents to automate existing QA/testing workflows and remove engineering friction. Build the applications and services that automation depends on, deploy them, and operate them in production environments. Take prototypes all the way. Build demos in a timely manner, gather feedback from the teams who'd use it, and iterate through successive versions until it's hardened, monitored, and running with matured quality. Identify gap areas in existing frameworks and tools, and iterate toward solutions that close them. What We Look For: 5-7+ years building production software, with demonstrated depth across test infrastructure, test frameworks, and developer tooling, and working knowledge of platform engineering. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

set the product vision and strategy Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). items.summary: Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $151,351 — $189,189 USD OTE (On Target Earning) $302,702 — $378,378 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability. items.title: Principal Engineer, Security at Reddit, Inc.
items.summary: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit
items.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. Reddit’s Platforms & Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute, storage, data, and platform services behind Reddit. This organization partners across the company to help protect Reddit’s users, products, and systems. We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to provide technical leadership across Reddit’s engineering organization. You’ll work with teams throughout the business to understand how systems and products work, identify security risks, and build practical solutions that fit the needs of the company. This is a broad, hands-on role that combines software and systems engineering, architecture, consulting, and mentorship. Security at Reddit is a collaborative effort. You’ll help teams make informed tradeoffs, document decisions, and build security into their work without creating unnecessary friction. You’ll also help the Security team grow its impact by sharing knowledge and developing future technical leaders. What you’ll do: Guide security architecture and technical direction across product, infrastructure, IT, and product engineering teams. Design and deliver security systems and improvements, including work in areas such as access control, cloud and Kubernetes security, identity and access management, observability, and CI/CD. Partner with teams on design reviews and threat modeling, helping them understand risks and choose appropriate mitigations. Lead complex security projects, from planning and technical design through implementation, migration, and operations. Provide practical security guidance on product features, service architecture, and engineering workflows. Improve security processes, documentation, runbooks, dashboards, and incident response practices. Help teams assess and communicate security risks, tradeoffs, and compliance needs. Mentor engineers and security practitioners through reviews, pairing, training, and technical leadership. Build connections across the organization so security work reflects how Reddit’s systems and business operate. Who you might be: An experienced security or software engineer who has led technical work across a large, complex organization. Skilled at securing systems across multiple domains, such as cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, web applications, identity and access management, or CI/CD. Comfortable writing and reviewing software, and able to understand systems deeply enough to offer useful, specific security guidance. Experienced with architecture reviews, threat modeling, security design, and communicating decisions in clear technical documents. Effective at leading complex projects that involve multiple teams, competing priorities, and real-world constraints. Pragmatic and collaborative: you can explain risk, find workable paths forward, and make sound decisions within an organization’s risk tolerance. A strong mentor who helps others develop security judgment and technical independence. An excellent communicator who can build trust with engineers and cross-functional partners. Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/. To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $268,700—$401,100 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors. Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build produc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-demand-generation-manager-auto

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

items.title: Customer Service Representative
items.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around! We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home. Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently. Why Choose ShyftOff? No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control. 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home. Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work. You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability. Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility. Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents The Role As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability. One of our newest programs include: Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around. What you'll do: Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.
