items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
items.summary: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
items.description: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. Interview Process Initial Application Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview Recruiter Screening Client Interview Final Selection & Onboarding Spark Hire Video Interview – Required As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire . After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. items.description: Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM) Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include: Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, Panama y Uruguay. Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities. Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data. Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards. Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration. Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices. Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations. Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding. Required Skills and Qualifications: Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date. Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later. Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols. Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration. Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture. Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively. Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection. Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration. Preferred Qualifications: Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines. Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling. Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications. Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week . Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding. Equipment Requirements Mobile: Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks. Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding. IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: Candidates who meet the project’s location and equipment requirements will be contacted soon to complete an identity verification process. Selected candidates should be able to complete this ID verification within 48 hours of being contacted. Successful verification is required before the contract can be issued for signature. Proven expertise in product catalog structuring, data normalization, and content creation for online stores. Experience with AI/LLM prompting, evaluation, or training is highly valued. Strong analytical thinking and a rigorous QA mindset; detail-oriented approach to scenario and data generation. Demonstrated understanding of consumer behavior and online shopping journeys. items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Culver City, California, United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kZSiaRVHB45MDzQ7znFJSV/jobs-at-crazy-maple-studio Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. Crazy Maple Studio, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/crazy-maple-studio-ai-assisted-story-writer-1099-contract

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission . To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows the Bundeswehr from the inside: how its structures work, how processes in logistics, maintenance or procurement really run, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships across the Bundeswehr and the defense ecosystem, and to position Celonis as a long-term partner for its digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of the armed forces into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships across the Bundeswehr – Army (Heer), Navy (Marine), Air Force (Luftwaffe) and Cyber and Information Domain Service (CIR) – and its ecosystem, e.g. the Federal Ministry of Defence (BMVg), the Federal Office of Bundeswehr Equipment, Information Technology and In-Service Support (BAAINBw) and BWI GmbH. Engage with decision-makers from leadership, logistics, procurement, IT and digitalization. Translate operational challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact, e.g. in logistics and supply, MRO and materiel readiness, supply chain resilience, procurement and IT modernization. Bring the voice of the Bundeswehr into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate defense procurement and tender processes (e.g. VSVgV, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and defense IT providers. Represent Celonis at public sector and defense events and conferences. The Qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the Bundeswehr , e.g. as an officer or civilian employee, ideally in a leadership role and/or in logistics, procurement, IT, digitalization, planning or organizational development. A solid network within the Bundeswehr and a deep understanding of its organization, decision-making and budget and planning processes (e.g. the procurement process CPM). First-hand understanding of the process and data challenges in areas such as logistics, materiel readiness, maintenance or procurement. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and English. Familiarity with defense procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-defense-bundeswehr

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Karnataka, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Telangana, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. Key Responsibilities: ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. ● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention. ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). ● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design. ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life. ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. ● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. ● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. What You’ll Bring ● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content. ● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar. ● Any Bachelor’s degree. ● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos). ● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics. ● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills. ● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and Telugu— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing. ● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines ● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks. Why This Role Is Exciting : ● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth. ● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams. ● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Albania URL: http://pavago.co Description SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. Interview Process Initial Application Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview Recruiter Screening Client Interview Final Selection & Onboarding Spark Hire Video Interview – Required As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire . After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results. #SEOSpecialist #DigitalMarketing #TechnicalSEO #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #LeadGeneration #AEO #GEO #MarketingAutomation #RemoteMarketingJobs #RemoteJobs #LI-AG1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: CINEMATIC VIDEO EDITOR – REAL ESTATE & CONSTRUCTION Salary range: up to Php 88,000 Philippine Peso/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.) Working Hours: Monday to Friday following New Zealand business time Work set-up: 100% Remote work (Independent Contractor Agreement) Holidays: TBC Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and assessment About the Company & Role Our client is a creative media production company specialising in producing professional visual content for businesses within the property, building, and construction sectors. The company provides a range of creative services, including photography, videography, aerial footage, and digital content production, helping businesses showcase their properties, projects, and services through compelling visual presentations. They are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Video Editor who can transform raw footage into polished, cinematic, and engaging video content that captures the quality and appeal of each project. The role involves editing various types of footage, including property walkthroughs, architectural spaces, construction developments, and commercial project showcases, while maintaining a consistent and professional visual style. The successful candidate will be expected to produce approximately 2–3 completed videos daily, balancing creative execution, technical quality, and production efficiency. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced editor who enjoys visual storytelling, understands cinematic editing techniques, and can deliver high-quality content in a fast-paced creative environment. Key Responsibilities Video Editing & Post-Production Edit raw video footage into professional, engaging, and cinematic video productions. Produce approximately 2–3 completed videos per day while maintaining consistent quality and creative standards. Create property walkthroughs, real estate promotional videos, architectural showcases, and construction project features. Apply professional editing techniques, including sequencing, transitions, pacing, music integration, and visual storytelling. Perform colour correction and colour grading to achieve a polished and consistent cinematic look. Edit and incorporate drone footage, interior and exterior shots, and other visual assets into cohesive video presentations. Adapt editing styles based on project requirements, target audiences, and creative direction. AI-Assisted Editing & Content Production Utilise AI-powered video editing and enhancement tools, particularly Higgsfield, to improve production workflows and creative output. Apply AI-assisted effects, enhancements, and visual elements while ensuring the authenticity and quality of the final content. Produce videos in different formats and aspect ratios, including landscape and vertical formats for various digital platforms. Optimise video content for online marketing and social media distribution. Ensure proper audio synchronisation, sound quality, captions, and overall video presentation. Quality Control & Project Management Review all completed videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional production standards before delivery. Manage multiple editing assignments and consistently meet daily production targets and deadlines. Maintain organised project files, raw footage, editing assets, and completed outputs. Implement feedback and revision requests promptly while maintaining attention to detail. Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows, turnaround times, and production efficiency. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Maintain consistency with the company's established creative direction and visual standards. Contribute creative ideas and recommendations to enhance the quality and impact of video content. Adjust editing approaches based on project requirements and client expectations. Collaborate with the team to ensure timely delivery and alignment with production objectives. Qualifications & Requirements Essential Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in video editing or post-production. Advanced proficiency in Final Cut Pro. Must have access to a Mac computer capable of running Final Cut Pro. Strong understanding of cinematic editing, storytelling, transitions, and video composition. Demonstrated experience in colour correction and professional colour grading. Proficiency in AI-powered video production tools, particularly Higgsfield. Strong understanding of audio synchronisation, sound design, music integration, and visual aesthetics. Ability to consistently deliver 2–3 completed videos per day without compromising quality. Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment. Must provide at least three (3) samples of previously produced landscape videos demonstrating editing skills and creative capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience editing real estate, property marketing, architectural, or construction-related videos. Experience incorporating drone footage into professional video productions. Knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, and visual effects. Familiarity with other AI-assisted video editing and content creation tools. Experience working with real estate professionals, property developers, builders, contractors, or commercial clients. Understanding of social media video formats and digital content requirements. Required Tools & Software Final Cut Pro: Advanced video editing and post-production. Higgsfield: AI-assisted video production, enhancement, and creative effects. Colour Grading Tools: Professional colour correction and grading capabilities. Audio Editing Tools: Sound design, audio synchronisation, and music integration. Video Exporting Tools: Experience preparing videos in landscape and vertical formats. Skills & Competencies Creative Storytelling: Ability to transform raw footage into visually compelling narratives. Strong Visual Aesthetic: Excellent eye for composition, lighting, colour, and pacing. Time Management: Capable of handling multiple projects and meeting daily production targets. Adaptability: Can work across different video styles and project requirements. Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy and consistency in every finished video. Coachability: Receptive to feedback and willing to make revisions when necessary. Reliability: Demonstrates accountability, effective communication, and consistency in delivering quality work. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-cinematic-video-editor-real-estate-construction

Good. So are we. Intellipet helps dog owners get the training their dogs need: in-home sessions with professional trainers, virtual coaching, and programs for everyday manners up to service-dog work. People call us because something isn’t working at home, and they need someone to help them fix it. That’s you. This job is for you if: You’re motivated by money and you’re not shy about it. Bonus weeks get you out of bed. You like people and want them to leave the call better off than they started. You can hear “I need to think about it” and know how to keep a conversation going. Learn their dog, their home and their goals, then match them to the right training program. Close the sale, handle objections, and set firm follow-ups. Hit weekly targets and watch your bonuses stack. What you get: $19.00/hr base pay , so you’re never at zero. Uncapped weekly bonuses. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/intellipet-sales-consultant-uncapped-bonuses

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-marketing-coordinator-paid-media

The category is young, so some of this you’ll figure out as you go. That’s expected. Responsibilities Own daily delivery leadership for the client’s AEO program, setting priorities, unblocking the team, and making sure work ships on time and to standard. Stay hands-on in the work itself, not just above it. You’ll be in the tools alongside the team. Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact with client-side counterparts, building trust and a reliable operating cadence. Define and document the practice’s methodology, frameworks, and playbooks so the capability can scale beyond incubation and transfer cleanly to the client. Establish prioritization and intake processes that balance real-time client requests against longer-term practice-building work. Coordinate across agency partners (strategy, content, SEO, analytics, and leadership) to keep the work aligned with the client’s broader marketing and business goals. Identify gaps in current tooling, reporting, and measurement for AEO performance, and recommend or build solutions. Turn early learnings into repeatable processes, training materials, and staffing recommendations for scaling the team. Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations to agency leadership and client stakeholders. Qualifications Direct experience leading an AEO or GEO program, start to finish. This is the non-negotiable one. Hands-on practitioner knowledge of how AI answer engines source and surface content: structured data, schema markup, content structuring for LLM retrieval, citation tracking and measurement. Solid SEO fundamentals underneath it. Delivery and program leadership experience in a fast-moving marketing, agency, or consulting environment. Strong client-facing communication and relationship management. Comfort with ambiguity and building process from scratch. Background we’d expect Most people who fit this have come from an agency or platform delivering AEO or GEO as a service. Think Scrunch, Bluefish, Athena, or similar. We’re also open to people who’ve built this capability inside a smaller business or for themselves. What matters is that you’ve actually done the work, not the size of the logo you did it for. Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.title: Business Development Representative – DACH (f/m/d) at Apaleo
items.summary: Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech! Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, pow
items.description: Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech! Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. As we continue to grow in the DACH market, we are looking for a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) (f/m/d) to generate new business opportunities and play a key role in our sales engine. Your Mission As a BDR at Apaleo, you are on the front line of our growth. You will be responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities for our Account Executives through a mix of inbound lead qualification and proactive outbound prospecting. This is a high-impact, target-driven role with a clear path towards an Account Executive position . What You’ll Be Up To Own and manage inbound leads with speed and strong qualification standards Proactively build pipeline through outbound prospecting (calls, email, LinkedIn) Consistently meet and exceed monthly targets (e.g. meetings booked, qualified opportunities) Run structured discovery conversations to understand customer needs and identify pain points Engage decision-makers in the hospitality industry and position Apaleo’s value proposition Collaborate closely with Account Executives to ensure high-quality handover of opportunities Leverage our partner ecosystem to identify and generate additional leads Maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoom, and Modjo to optimise your performance What You’ll Bring to the Team Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS, sales development, or a comparable commercial role Strong interest in outbound prospecting and building pipeline Comfortable working with targets, KPIs, and performance metrics Excellent communication skills in German and English (minimum C1 level required for both, for the DACH market) Confidence in engaging and challenging decision-makers Strong discovery and listening skills, you know how to uncover real customer needs High level of resilience, ownership, and drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment Curiosity and willingness to learn, especially in a tech-driven product environment Extra consideration for: Experience in hospitality or hospitality tech or SaaS or similar background Familiarity with modern sales tools (e.g. HubSpot, Sales Navigator etc.) Additional language proficiency in Italian or Spanish, or French is a plus What We Offer Career & Growth Clear and structured career path towards Account Executive or other revenue roles Dedicated onboarding and continuous sales training (tools, product, methodologies) Regular feedback cycles and development support Opportunity to join a fast-growing SaaS company and directly impact revenue growth Culture & Growth A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact. Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration. Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life. Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution. Perks & Lifestyle Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business. Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket . Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events. Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired. Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.
