items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products. You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets. You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket. Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side. In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands. Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality. Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt. Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement. Participate in on-call rotation and incident response. Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards. Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own. Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services. 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs. Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed. Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling. A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner. A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale." Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers. Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it. Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar. Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms. Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog). AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900
items.description: Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io. Astronomer is investing in a global ecosystem that helps customers get more value from Astro and helps our partners grow their businesses with us. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Ecosystem Strategy and Programs to build the strategy, solutions, growth, and intelligence capabilities that will scale this business. The initial focus is establishing these high leverage growth Partner Programs in accordance with a defined and targeted Partner Strategy. This includes setting strategy and business plans, building partner solutions and technical enablement, creating partner-led and product-led growth programs, and developing the intelligence, tools, automation, and AI that improve decisions and execution. You’ll stay close to partners and opportunities as you build repeatable systems for onboarding, joint go-to-market, customer adoption, and expansion. This role reports to the Vice President of Global Partner Ecosystem and is suited to a strategic, hands-on leader who can move between executive alignment, program design, and practical execution. Location: Remote-based / Hybrid in NYC or San Francisco Bay Area As Senior Director, Ecosystem Strategy and Programs, you’ll get to: Set the ecosystem strategy and program architecture: Define partner segments, priorities, engagement models, program principles, and the partner journey from recruitment and onboarding through activation, growth, and renewal. Lead ecosystem and GTM business planning: Identify the partners, markets, solutions, and programs with the greatest growth potential, translate priorities into plans, and drive cross-functional execution. Build programs around shared customer outcomes: Create clear participation paths, value propositions, requirements, benefits, and success measures for technology, cloud, services, and strategic partners. Make partner economics work: Develop scalable approaches to partner incentives, co-investment, marketplace motions, and joint business planning in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership. Turn partnerships into pipeline and adoption: Establish repeatable co-sell, referral, solution development, and customer expansion motions with clear ownership, qualification, handoffs, and feedback loops. Build partner solutions capabilities: Lead partner solution architecture, technical onboarding and enablement, integrations, and joint solution development. Help partners position, integrate, and deliver Astronomer, and connect partner-led opportunities with the right technical resources. Equip partners to reach the market: Work with Marketing and Sales to develop partner messaging, campaigns, events, solution briefs, case studies, and field enablement that generate demand and improve deal execution. Accelerate ecosystem and product-led growth: Develop programs across acquisition, activation, lifecycle engagement, adoption, consumption growth, retention, and expansion in partnership with Product, Sales, and Customer Success. Create a consistent partner experience: Simplify program requirements, onboarding, enablement, partner communications, and internal processes so partners can focus on customers and growth. Build the operating system for the ecosystem: Own program governance, planning cadences, partner business reviews, performance reporting, and cross-functional accountability. Develop ecosystem intelligence and AI capabilities: Build business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, enabling tools, and automation. Use data and AI to surface growth opportunities, improve decision quality, and increase GTM productivity. Expand shared GTM support as the ecosystem scales: Apply proven strategy, growth, and intelligence capabilities to cross-functional GTM priorities, including customer growth and retention initiatives and AI-enabled ways of working. Measure business outcomes: Track partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue, partner onboarding and productivity, acquisition and activation, customer adoption, consumption, retention and expansion, and the impact of shared GTM programs. Represent Astronomer with partners and the industry: Build trusted executive relationships and communicate a compelling vision for how partners can grow alongside Astronomer. What success looks like A scalable ecosystem strategy with the programs, partner solutions, team capabilities, and infrastructure needed to support partners in delivering net new logos, customer expansion, and capabilities in emergent Airflow use cases.. Faster partner onboarding, stronger technical capabilities, and higher partner productivity. Increased partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue. More effective ecosystem and product-led acquisition, activation, and conversion. Improved customer adoption, consumption, retention, and expansion. Better GTM decisions and execution through actionable intelligence, scalable operations, and AI-enabled productivity. A shared GTM growth capability that improves strategic execution and commercial effectiveness across Astronomer. What we’re looking for: 10+ years of experience in partner ecosystems, alliances, channels, partner programs, or related go-to-market leadership roles, including significant experience in enterprise software, cloud, data, or developer platforms. 5+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional programs, with a record of setting strategy and delivering measurable results. Experience designing or scaling a partner program, including partner segmentation, onboarding, enablement, benefits, incentives, performance standards, and governance. A track record of building partner motions that create measurable business impact, such as sourced or influenced pipeline, revenue, customer adoption, marketplace growth, or successful delivery. Experience translating business strategy into growth programs across acquisition, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion. Experience building or using business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, or operating tools to identify opportunities and improve execution. Strong understanding of partner go-to-market models, including co-selling, referrals, joint business planning, solution development, and cloud marketplace programs. Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to deliver programs with shared accountability. A data-driven approach to program design and investment. You can define useful metrics, interpret performance, and adjust resources based on results. Practical experience applying automation or AI to improve GTM decisions, workflows, or team productivity. Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across senior internal leaders and external partner executives. Strategic thinking paired with a bias toward action. You can set direction, make sound tradeoffs, and stay close to execution as programs take shape. Comfort with ambiguity and pace in a high-growth company, and a collaborative, low-ego style that fits a no-handoffs culture. Bonus points if you have: Experience in an open-source, data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, or developer-tools ecosystem. Familiarity with Apache Airflow, data orchestration, or the modern data stack. Experience building partner programs at a SaaS company moving from early ecosystem development to global scale. Experience with cloud partner programs, marketplace listings and private offers, co-sell systems, partner relationship management tools, or channel incentive operations. Experience building partner communities, certification or accreditation programs, solution validation frameworks, or partner-delivered services practices. #LI-remote At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

items.title: Content Creator - YouTube
items.summary: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. Benefits 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays 10 paid sick days per year Medical, dental, and vision coverage A 401(k) with employer contributions (US) How to apply Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit building tools that help voters make informed decisions and participate in democracy. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, we're creating digital solutions that improve voter engagement and access to trustworthy election information. We're seeking a Managing Editor to lead the day-to-day editorial operations of WeVote's content programs, including our blog, newsletters, and voter education initiatives. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced editor, journalist, or content leader who is passionate about civic engagement and wants to make a meaningful impact through high-quality, nonpartisan journalism. What You'll Do ✅ Manage the editorial calendar and publication workflow for blogs, newsletters, and voter education content ✅ Edit, review, and publish content that meets high standards for accuracy, clarity, and nonpartisan integrity ✅ Lead and mentor a team of volunteer writers, researchers, and content contributors ✅ Coordinate content assignments, deadlines, and production schedules ✅ Maintain editorial guidelines, style standards, and fact-checking processes ✅ Collaborate with product, communications, marketing, and political data teams to identify and develop compelling content opportunities ✅ Help grow audience engagement through clear, informative, and impactful storytelling What We're Looking For 3+ years of experience in editing, journalism, content strategy, publishing, communications, or a related field Strong copyediting, proofreading, and content development skills Experience managing editorial workflows and publication schedules Ability to coach writers and provide constructive editorial feedback Familiarity with digital publishing platforms, newsletters, and CMS tools Excellent organizational and project management skills Commitment to nonpartisan voter education and civic engagement Comfortable working in a fully remote, volunteer-driven environment Why Join WeVote? Help strengthen democracy through voter education and civic technology Lead mission-driven editorial initiatives with national impact Collaborate with passionate professionals across journalism, technology, product, and communications Expand your leadership and editorial management experience Build your portfolio while contributing to an innovative nonprofit organization Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5-10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position About WeVote WeVote is a nonpartisan, nonprofit civic technology organization dedicated to helping voters make informed choices. Through innovative digital tools, trusted voter information, and community engagement, we work to increase participation in every election. * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-managing-editor-volunteer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position : Marketing & Content Coordinator Salary : $1,800–$2,000 AUD per month Working Hours & Conditions: Observing AU working hours Holidays : Observing AU holidays ROLE OVERVIEW: A leading Australian financial planning and wealth management firm is seeking a proactive, creative, and highly organized Marketing & Content Coordinator to support ongoing growth. Rooted in a philosophy that financial planning should create clarity, structure, and confidence rather than complex jargon, the business empowers clients to navigate financial decisions with ease. In this hands-on, remote role, you will work directly with the business owner to transform raw ideas, company updates, and industry insights into engaging digital content. Leveraging modern AI-powered marketing workflows, you will take complete ownership of day-to-day execution, content scheduling, and campaign management to expand the firm's online footprint. RESPONSIBILITIES: Collaborate directly with the business owner to extract marketing concepts, operational updates, and relevant financial insights for digital campaigns. Produce compelling organic social media and digital content tailored to professional services and wealth management audiences. Leverage AI-powered marketing platforms (such as Avery and ChatGPT) to generate, refine, and scale brand-aligned content briefs and drafts. Manage and maintain a structured, consistent content calendar across relevant social media channels and scheduling platforms. Audit and refine AI-generated outputs for absolute accuracy, professional tone, and compliance with high advisory standards. Monitor social media performance metrics, track engagement trends, and proactively recommend data-driven content enhancements. Coordinate digital marketing assets, resource libraries, and feedback loops to ensure smooth, uninterrupted workflow execution. QUALIFICATIONS: Experience: Mid-level experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media management, or marketing coordination. Content & Copywriting: Proven track record of developing engaging organic social media content paired with strong copywriting and editing skills. Digital & AI Proficiency: Comfort and familiarity using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) and marketing automation platforms to streamline content creation. Organizational Mastery: Strong experience managing content calendars, scheduling software, and maintaining multi-channel execution timelines. Autonomy & Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the independence, attention to detail, and initiative to manage daily operations with minimal oversight. DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED): Industry Background: Prior experience marketing professional services, financial planning, or wealth management firms. Creative Tooling: Hands-on proficiency with design and management tools such as Canva, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn, and major scheduling platforms. Analytical Capability: Experience reviewing social media analytics and translating performance data into actionable growth strategies. Cross-Cultural Collaboration: Demonstrated history of working directly with Australian business owners or remote executive teams. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-marketing-content-coordinator

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results. AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works. We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow. What You'll Do You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work. Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers. Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication. Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high. Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products. Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out. Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve. You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life. What We're Looking For You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand. You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work. You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth. You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively. You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content. You're creative, proactive, and independent . You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results. You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products . Why Join Us? We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team. You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business. We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results. What We Offer 100% remote work with an international team. Paid time off and national holidays to recharge. Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being. Computer budget for a comfortable workspace. Kindle and access to our company Amazon account. Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world. Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact. Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative (Motion Design) to push the boundaries of what’s possible in motion and animation. In this role, you’ll lead a global team of top-tier creatives, delivering world-class motion graphics, digital ads, explainer videos, promos, animated presentations, and more. You’ll shape creative strategy, inspire your team, and partner with leading global brands to deliver impactful work that blends craft, innovation, and cutting-edge technology.
